response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, including geospatial data processing with the GISCollective project. However, his primary expertise is in Node.js, TypeScript, and Dlang, with limited recent experience in modern C++ or Rust, which are critical for this role. His background also lacks specific experience with routing/navigation systems or high-performance distributed systems in a routing context.
strengths: Strong background in geospatial data processing and GIS systems (GISCollective project)
Experience with distributed systems and low-latency applications (Dunnhumby media)
Proven ability to learn new technologies and tools quickly across diverse stacks
concerns: Limited recent experience with modern C++ or Rust, which are required for this role
No clear evidence of work with routing/navigation systems or routing data pipelines
Background heavily skewed toward web/mobile development rather than systems programming
